title: Trademark Physiques
desc:
Created by Coach Landon from TMP employing 3 upper body days, 1 lower and a fasted cardio day. This is to keep a lean physique while still building muscle. Employs warmup mobility work before starting the exercises with working sets and back off sets. I am his client and have his permission to post this. Be sure to follow a proper lean diet for best results! Reach out to Landon for further details:

https://www.trademarkphysiques.com/pages/coach-landon
